description: Aree Non Idonee all'installazione di impianti alimentati da Fonti di Energia Rinnovabile (FER) is a dataset listed in Italian Catalogue of metadata for Spatial Data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by cartografia.sit.puglia.it. Consultation of the documentation and cartographic component of R. R. 24 of 30 December 2010 on the identification of areas and sites not suitable for the installation of specific types of plants powered by renewable sources in the territory of the Puglia Region. Coverage: IT. The portal shows the English title as "Areas Not suitable for the installation of plants powered by Renewable Energy Sources (FER)" (machine-translated by the portal). The listing shows 3 download or service links in WMS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-rndt.
